about: The agent-scan eval set (D421-D425): each case is one agent's scan in one frozen world.
A world is a dated dump of production, copied out of the backup rotation by
`scripts/eval-world.sh freeze`, restored into a disposable database and run with the clock
set to the moment the dump was taken. The dumps are not in the repository: they hold every
row of the database. This file names them; the runner refuses a run when one is missing.
Every world was dumped while the US market was closed, so the last stored close is the
price at that moment. The set says nothing about a scan made while the market is open.
An agent is named as it is on production. Read by services/ai/scripts/run_agent_eval.py.
